public_api_decisions.direction: Current @api declaration and public extension index explicitly retain the existing persister API and type dispatch adapter; two-type HTTP writes remain regression coverage.

Latest bundle documents active typed dispatch through supports(sourceType) and relationship reader/updater tags. Dedicated two-type external dispatch verification is still needed; the previous claim of no active seam is obsolete.
RelationshipReadMap and CustomRouteMetadata are explicitly public @api DTOs; public signature regression tests retain the consumer contract.

public_api_decisions.surface: dx.* / errors.locale / inactive Doctrine performance options
public_api_decisions.direction: Inactive dx configuration, errors.locale and the five inactive Doctrine options are explicitly deprecated as unimplemented. CONFIG_ONLY inventory entries remain historical/deprecated surface, not stable working features.
The capability, locator and getRepositoryForType method are now explicit @api. Safe tenant/scope forwarding and null fallback remain required and externally tested.
